correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation of the published log-likelihood gives strictly negative diagonal Hessian entries and zero cross derivative. The article defines observed information as minus this Hessian, so the information entries must be the corresponding positive sums. The printed negative entries instead equal the Hessian. Their inverse is negative definite, forcing a negative delta-method quadratic form for every nonzero gradient. The packaged checker verifies analytic versus numerical second derivatives and a concrete stress-strength variance.
